$comment: Contract Verification Aggregation SEP (draft) — an aggregator's page of the bulk-load stream. The envelope is the Results SEP's stellar-verification-page, unchanged and under the same schema value; only `records` differs, which is why this is a second file rather than a branch in that one — a verifier implementing only the Results SEP validates against a document that cannot mention aggregation.
title: Contract Verification Bulk-Load Page, aggregated (Aggregation SEP 1.0)
description: The body of GET /v1/wasms on an aggregator: records are whole stellar-verification-aggregate documents, because an aggregator's value is that a consumer gets one stream instead of traversing a Trusted Verifiers List and synchronising against every member.

schema.description: The document type, and the same value a verifier's page carries: the envelope is one document type serving two roles, and a consumer knows which record shape it will get because it knows which role it asked.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this envelope, and of the envelope only: a relayed entry inside a record carries the schema_version of the document it was read from, and this field never restates it.

order.description: The direction this page pages in, echoed back so a consumer never has to remember what it asked for.

cursor.description: The cursor for the next page, {timestamp}-{wasm_hash}; null at the end of the stream. Opaque, and valid only within the stream that issued it: this stream is ordered by the aggregator's own assembly clock, a verifier's by that verifier's publication update time, and the two share a format while meaning different positions.

records.description: This page's records, in `order`. Empty is a valid page and means the stream has caught up, not that the aggregator has nothing.
